name: Book highlights
description: Your highlights from the ePub reader as full-screen quotes, one at a time: the passage as big as the screen takes, the book, its author and chapter, and your note. A new one every hour (or as often as you set), the one you made last first. Tap, swipe, the arrows or the buttons for the next; a long press opens the book at it. Can show a Kindle's My Clippings.txt too.
